**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 24 hits our preferred position on every material term:
- **§ 24.1** — we may assign to an Affiliate or M&A/asset-sale successor without Vendor consent (prompt notice + assignee assumption only).
- **§ 24.2** — Vendor cannot assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (not unreasonably withheld), and never to a direct competitor.
- **§ 24.3** — residual assignments subject to a mutual "not unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed" standard.
- **§ 24.4** — our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service; Vendor must cooperate with successor administration.
- **§ 13.3** — licence transfer rights track a Section 24 permitted assignment, so no back-door licence restriction.

I also checked the rest of the document for change-of-control or assignment-triggered Vendor rights; the only related provision is the mutual insolvency termination right in § 9.2, which expressly carves out lawful reorganizations that do not impair performance and so does not undercut § 24.4.
